title: The Vanished Customs House
rumor: The Vanished Customs House. An old stone customs post once stood along a remote river channel, collecting tolls from passing merchants. It was abandoned after the channel shifted and eventually disappeared from modern maps. Boatmen claim its strongroom was never emptied and that its ledgers still contain records of cargo whose owners vanished during the war.
first_lead: An old commercial chart in Westbridge depicts the former channel and landing.
